statements.status_notes: crypto-bigint 0.7.6 fixes this advisory; that is a major-version upgrade from 0.5.x.  The bundled copy ships inside the py-rattler build that the base environment installs through conda-rattler-solver. No published py-rattler build bundles a fixed version of this crate yet, so this finding stays under investigation until one does.
